source_title: Great Books #6: The Intimacy of Love
summary: This March 11, 2026 Odyssey lecture is already public source spine for Love Recognizes The Other: love is concrete recognition through private signs, rooted memory, and relation rather than possession, fame, empire, or mere togetherness.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Odysseus and Penelope recognize each other through secret signs dense enough to carry shared life while staying hidden from a hostile room.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Love Recognizes page already anchors this source in the shared-sign and secret-language mechanism.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The immovable bed tests whether Odysseus is still rooted in the life he made with Penelope rather than still chasing glory.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The bed scene is the source's clearest concrete-recognition test and is already part of the stable public anchor evidence.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the intimate-recognition origin layer, where love speaks through public and private language at once, makes another person visible without exposing them to hostile listeners, and tests whether the beloved remains rooted in a shared life.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Love Recognizes owns the relational recognition test. Do not broaden this into a generic romance, Odyssey, or love catalog page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source only as child-page support for the broader heart claim that relation, love, and shared memory are human constraints a social order cannot erase without damage.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart is the parent civilizational measure. The narrower secret-language, recognition, anti-possession, and relation tests belong on Love Recognizes.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the source as secondary Great Books / epic evidence only when revising how Homeric scenes carry heart-knowledge and shared memory into civilization.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the medium and civilizational memory. Love Recognizes owns the relational mechanism exposed by the Odyssey scenes.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-03-11, this Odyssey lecture is the public intimate-recognition layer before the March 18 and March 25 anti-Homer/Aeneid inversion lectures intensify the negative imperial anti-love branch.

The source states the broader value hierarchy that love and family outrank glory, fame, empire, and heroic death, but the active mechanism is relational recognition through shared signs rather than the whole human-heart social-order test.

next_actions.action: Do not create standalone Love, Secret Language, Odysseus, Penelope, Marriage Bed, Golden Brooch, Odyssey Homecoming, Achilles Regrets Fame, Greek Love, or Family Beats Empire pages from this source alone.

Keep Secret Language Of Love as a named submechanism inside Love Recognizes, not a new lens seed. A standalone page would duplicate the child page unless later sources repeatedly need a separate hover surface for encoded intimacy.

If provenance maintenance becomes useful, consider a source-scoped episode-link pass from the strongest read marks to lens-point:heart-love-recognizes-person, especially the buried-sentence/private-sign and immovable-bed marks; do not add one-off links unless reader navigation pressure warrants it.
